result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the 'Popular right now' restaurant card has a truncated title colliding with the rating block, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' card is clipped mid-character by the rating block on the same row, so the name renders as 'Tokumaru Ramei'. This is a full-width vertical card, not a horizontal carousel edge.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with the rating pinned right, and add proper text truncation with an ellipsis (or allow wrapping) so the name is never cut mid-glyph.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with dark outline, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circular button with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) has a light gray image background while sibling thumbnails use dark backgrounds, and its white '15–25 min' badge has low contrast against that light background.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail background treatment or add a subtle scrim/shadow behind time badges so they remain legible on light imagery.
